summary:
The Arceus VSTAR numbered GG70 closes the Galarian Gallery, occupying the final number in the subset that defined Crown Zenith and, with it, the end of the Sword and Shield era. That position is not incidental to how the card is collected. GG70 is the last card in the last gallery of a generation, and the Pokemon chosen for it is the one Pokemon lore treats as first: Arceus, described as the original being, credited with shaping the world the rest of the mythology occupies. Putting the creator Pokemon in the terminal slot of a generation-closing subset is a deliberate piece of design, and collectors read it that way.

### Basic Info
*   **Main subject / card theme:** Arceus in its VSTAR form
*   **Set or product (catalog label):** 2023 Sword and Shield Crown Zenith Galarian Gallery Secret Rare
*   **Card number:** GG70
*   **Language version(s):** English catalog entry
*   **Rarity / treatment:** Galarian Gallery secret rare VSTAR
*   **Set label year:** 2023

### Community Pulse
Cards that terminate a subset attract collectors for structural reasons on top of aesthetic ones - the last number is the one a completed run ends on, and that gives GG70 a symbolic weight beyond its artwork. Threads reflect it: discussion tends to treat this card as the endpoint of the Sword and Shield era rather than as one option among Crown Zenith's chases. Arceus contributes its own lore-driven following, drawn from collectors who pursue mythical Pokemon specifically. The recurring practical topic is the same one that shapes every Crown Zenith card: English-language distribution ran through elite trainer boxes, tins and premium collections rather than standard booster boxes, so supply is inferred from product routes instead of read off a print run. Condition discussion focuses on foil surface, since open artwork areas on cards of this era show print lines and light scratching plainly.

### Card Fun Facts
*   Arceus is presented in Pokemon lore as the original being from which the rest of the world follows, making it the mythology's foundational figure rather than simply another Legendary.
*   GG70 is the final number of the Galarian Gallery, so it is the card on which a completed subset run ends.
*   Crown Zenith closed the Sword and Shield era, which means the last card of its signature subset functions as a generational bookend.

### Summary (TLDR)
GG70 Arceus VSTAR is the final card of Crown Zenith's Galarian Gallery - the creator Pokemon in the terminal slot of the subset that closed the Sword and Shield era. It carries completionist demand from collectors finishing the run plus lore-driven interest in Arceus, while collection-led distribution makes its supply a matter of inference rather than published figures.
